The 2022 same-step paper studies r(nd) parity runs, not r(n+d)-r(n) frequencies. 2024 generalized block result concerns many-block Gaussian asymptotics and was only checked at abstract level. An earlier exact finding concerns different two-active-bit shifts 2^a+1 and does not imply the Mersenne family.
